abilities.effect: A skeletal arm swings a sickle from the ceiling, making a Strike against the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Sickle
abilities.trigger: A creature attempts to open the door

hazard.description: A skeletal arm holding a sickle is concealed in the ceiling and connected to a mechanism in the sliding door below it.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) on the door frame or ceiling groove, or Interact to operate a lever on the opposite side of the door (in areas D2 and D4, respectively)
hazard.name: Sickle Blades
hazard.reset: The trap resets after 15 minutes. Additionally, a creature can manually Interact with the lever on the opposite side of the door to reset the trap.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
